topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well, I can’t say as I’m surprised someone found something they didn’t bury. There’s more in this earth than seeds and stones, though I’ve never found much myself beyond the dales of my plow. That odd box, it’s got me thinking on the Saints, and how they say we might find accounts of our deeds in the world after. A man should keep his doings close to his heart and closer still to his word. But, ah, the eras pass and we forget what we’ve sown, or what we might’ve lost to the earth’s forgiving grasp. I reckon it’s best to confess what we can, and pray for the rest.
